name: docker-node-php-rsync
description: php with npm and composer and rsync

scripts.build: npm run build:latest && npm run build:current
scripts.build:current: docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t jpmschuler/docker-node-php-rsync:$(npm pkg get version | tr -d '"') .
scripts.dockerpush: npm run dockerpush:latest && npm run dockerpush:current
scripts.dockerpush:current: docker push jpmschuler/docker-node-php-rsync:$(npm pkg get version | tr -d '"')
scripts.tag:current: git tag $(npm pkg get version | tr -d '"')
scripts.release: npm run build && npm run dockerpush && npm run git:push
